about_short_description.short_description: Raqamyah Platform is a regulated peer to peer (P2P) financing platform by Saudi Arabian Monetary Authority (SAMA).

product.name: SME Crowd Lending Platform
product.description: A regulated online platform connecting creditworthy small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) seeking financing with individual and institutional investors for peer-to-peer debt funding.

product.name: Invoice Financing
product.description: A short-term financing product that provides SMEs with liquidity by financing their outstanding invoices through the platform.

product.name: Portfolio Diversification Advisory
product.description: A service that guides investors on diversifying their investment portfolio across multiple SME financing requests to reduce risk.

identifier.value: Credit Risk Assessment and Selection Process

product.name: Credit Risk Assessment and Selection Process
product.description: A credit evaluation service that assesses SME financing requests for creditworthiness and risk before listing them for investor funding.

product.name: Automated and Manual Investment Options
product.description: Investment methods allowing investors to either manually select SME financing opportunities or use automated tools to allocate funds based on predefined criteria.

identifier.value: Financee (Debtor) Account Management and Intermediary Services

product.name: Financee (Debtor) Account Management and Intermediary Services
product.description: Services for SMEs including account management, credit facilitation, contract preparation, payment collection, and distribution as a financing agent.
